newsitem.title: USA: CNG Energy had strong start on power sales.
newsitem.headline: CNG Energy had strong start on power sales.

text.p: CNG Energy Services Corp said Thursday it is off to a strong start on 1997 wholesale power sales.

The Consolidated Natural Gas Co subsidiary said it more than tripled power sales in the first quarter compared with the same period a year ago. CNG Energy sold 2.6 million megawatt-hours of electricity in the first three months of this year versus sales of 800,000 megawatt-hours in the first three months of 1996.

"The first-quarter sales also equal more than half the power we sold in all of last year," said Thomas E. Dodd, vice president, power. "We are definitely off to a strong start to reach our goal of tripling sales for all of 1997."
Describing itself as one of the nation's 10 largest independent wholesale power marketers, CNG Energy said it sold 5.0 million megawatt-hours of electricity in 1996.
